answer: A social-graph distance rule weights an agent by its shortest staked path to trusted seeds, so a cluster on the tundra fringe earns almost nothing. Only edges with a 25-credit sponsor stake and three joint tasks count, and weight ends at the three-hop ledge from any seed. A zephyr link, one unstaked interaction, never shortens distance, so the kth fake still needs its own bridge with no reuse: 1,000 fakes lock 25,000 credits, while an honest agent pays one stake and keeps full weight. Bridge rental fails because a renting sponsor forfeits its stake and seed proximity.
